title: Send Images to the Media Service
description: An HTTPS API needs /images requests sent to one service and /orders requests to another. Which routing capability is required?

options.text: An HTTP-aware L7 proxy with access to the request path.
options.explanation: Path routing requires parsing HTTP, typically after TLS termination. Decide whether to re-encrypt the backend hop.

options.text: An L4 balancer looking only at IP addresses and ports.
options.explanation: Those fields do not reveal the encrypted HTTP path.

options.text: DNS records that inspect each request's URL path.
options.explanation: DNS resolves names before the HTTP request and does not receive its path.

options.text: Round robin alone, without inspecting HTTP.
options.explanation: Round robin spreads traffic but cannot choose a service based on a URL path.
